author: Animalogic
description:
Meet the binturong: the "disheveled old man" of the Southeast Asian jungle. Though they look like a mix between a bear and a cat, these large, tree-dwelling omnivores are in a league of their own.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
